_comment: Only figures the site itself evidences. The previous file claimed 2,500 students served annually and 45 courses offered; neither is supported by anything we publish, and both contradicted ESLP's own alumni count. Every number here can be checked against a page: alumni against the ESLP cohort record, subjects against the Academy catalogue, tracks against code.edlight.org/tracks, partners against the logos on the homepage. Update these by hand when the underlying record changes.
